pages.text: A few quality of life things that can be nice to get while you're in the first simulation.

Heights can be scary, so you might want to craft a couple of $(item)Slime Boots$() to keep you safe from any sort of falldamage.$(br2)Slime can easily be found in $(item)Lush Swamps$() in this simulation.
You can upgrade your $(l:portal_hub/5_hook)Hook$() to a much faster version, with a lot more reach.
This hang glider complements your $(l:portal_hub/5_hook)Hook$() really well and make you travel even faster.

pages.title: Tools
pages.text: You can get through the first simulation without any fancy $(item)Tools$(), but if you want to make them you can.
Read this book for more information about making$(br)$(item)Tools$().
Fill this thing up with $(item)Water$() and you are good to go.$(br2)Excellent for giving crops a gentle nudge in the right direction.

pages.title: Chest Transporters
pages.text: If you need to move your $(item)Chests$() or $(item)Drawers$() don't lift with your back, instead use the handy $(item)Chest Transporters$().

pages.title: Drawers
pages.text: Can hold many stacks of the same item. The full sized one can hold $(item)512 stacks$(), or around 33k items (for items that stack up to 64).$(br2)When the drawer is dismantled, the containing items will still stay inside.

pages.title: Compacting Drawers
pages.text: When a convertable item is inside, like for example an $(item)Iron Ingot$(), it will allow the user to also interact with the compacted/dilluted form of the item.$(br2)Which in this case would be $(item)Iron Blocks$() and $(item)Iron Nuggets$()

pages.title: Backpacks
pages.text: You can make equippable backpacks a bit into this simulation. Handy for storing $(item)Tools$() and $(item)Snacks$(). Can be equipped in the body bauble slot.$(br2)Open keybind: $(item)$(k:Open Backpack)$()

A dank null is a thing of wonder. It will store items up to a threshold, and after reaching that threshold it will $(item)Destroy$() the items.$(br2)It will automatically collect drops that matches the current contents.
As you upgrade your dank null it can hold more item types, and every slot can hold more items.

$(item)Building Wands$() is a tool that lets you place multiple blocks down at a time.$(br2)The stone wand is somewhat limited, but later tiers like $(item)Diamond$() or $(item)Unbreakable$() is very useful.
Nifty headgear that will make the wearer see in the dark.
